summary: NEXORIA Phase 2 backend testing — GUILDS (creation gates+validation, list/mine/detail, invites send/accept/decline, role change, kick/leave/disband, chat, vault deposit/withdraw + XP/level recompute), FORUM (6 categories enriched, threads CRUD+pin+lock staff-only, replies w/ notif, locked-thread rejection, delete by author/staff/forbidden), SEASONS (create auto-ends previous, current/list, full lifecycle with end-distribution, leaderboard, grant_xp() mirror into season_scores). Built /app/backend/tests/test_phase2_guilds_forum_seasons.py — 31 tests / 30 PASS / 1 SKIP (skip = known missing badge def, see backend_issues). Phase 1 batch5 still 15/15 PASS — no regressions.

minor.issue: grant_badge() called with badge IDs 'scholar', 'founder_guild', 'season_champion', 'season_elite' which are NOT defined in BADGES list in /app/backend/game_data.py. grant_badge() silently returns False, so users never actually receive these badges. Code path runs without raising — appears successful but no badge granted. Fix: add the 4 badge defs in game_data.py BADGES array (id/name/category/icon/rarity/description/color), or remove the grant_badge() calls.

Server reads thread document BEFORE incrementing 'views' field, so the FIRST GET response returns pre-increment value (e.g., 0 on first view). The DB is updated correctly so the NEXT GET shows the bump. UX consequence: users see 'Vues: 0' immediately after opening a thread until they refresh. Fix: either (a) increment in-memory `thread['views']+=1` before returning, or (b) use find_one_and_update with $inc + return_document=AFTER.

action_items: Add 4 missing badge definitions in /app/backend/game_data.py BADGES: scholar (forum thread author), founder_guild (guild founder), season_champion (season rank 1), season_elite (season ranks 2-10). Without these, grant_badge() is a silent no-op for these IDs.
Fix GET /api/forum/threads/{id} to return views POST-increment (find_one_and_update + return_document=AFTER, or local +=1 before return).

critical_code_review_comments: GUILDS code-quality is high: gating order is correct (level → aether → membership) with clear French error messages; chef leave auto-promotes officier first, then any member, then disbands+cascades (deletes guild + members + chat) — defensive cascade, no orphans.
Guild vault deposit recomputes level via `1 + xp // 1000` and updates only when changed — clean. Member contribution_xp tracked separately from guild xp (good for leaderboards).

Forum: thread+reply size validation (5-120 title / 10-5000 content / 2-2000 reply) is server-side; pin/lock are toggles via $set with not-of-current-value (atomic toggle). Cascade delete drops replies — correct.

Season grant_xp() mirror is idempotent (upsert + $inc + $setOnInsert.first_seen_at). Verified: after forum-thread creation by a fresh user, db.season_scores has a row with season_xp >= 30 for that user — leaderboard works.

Season end: rewards distributed per rank tier (rank==1 / 2-10 / 11-50), $inc on user aether + notification — uses limit(50) on sort, so rank 51+ get nothing (matches spec). Double-end protected with 400.
Auto-end-previous on /admin/seasons creation: `update_many({active:True}, $set:{active:False, ended_at})` — verified by creating two consecutive seasons; first becomes inactive.
Minor: /api/seasons/current has no Depends(get_user_dep) — endpoint is PUBLIC. Probably intended (landing-page display), but worth confirming.
Minor: GET /api/guilds requires auth but result doesn't filter by visibility — all guilds public. OK for now.
Forum delete cascade only drops replies; doesn't drop notifications referencing thread. Low priority.
Validation gap: /api/guilds POST allows any banner_color string (no hex/length check). Cosmetic — low priority.

(8) BADGE IDS 'scholar','founder_guild','season_champion','season_elite' all silently NO-OP in grant_badge() because not in BADGES list — REPORT.
rca of the issue: 1) Missing badge defs: BADGES array in game_data.py is the source of truth — grant_badge() does `badge_def = next((b for b in BADGES if b['id'] == badge_id), None); if not badge_def: return False`. So calls to grant_badge with IDs not in BADGES fail silently. Fix: add 4 entries to BADGES. 2) Forum views off-by-one on first display: get_forum_thread() at L2114 calls `find_one()` then `update_one($inc:views:1)` — the returned dict has the pre-increment value. Use find_one_and_update with ReturnDocument.AFTER, or simply mutate thread['views']+=1 in Python before returning. Both bugs are MINOR and do not break core flows; all 30 active tests pass.
